description: This file is a shell script used to generate and set cron jobs for CPU fragmentation collection based on a time interval parameter. It defines functions to calculate cron patterns for different time ranges, modifies crontab entries accordingly, and uses environment variables and command-line arguments to control scheduling behavior.

methods.name: getCronPattern
methods.description: Calculates a cron pattern based on the input time interval, adjusting schedule frequency for intervals less than, equal to, or greater than specified hours (24, 48, 72, 96, 120).
